title: P18: no per-field length caps on room-policy primitives
description: room-policy-04 Appendix B defines Uri/MediaType/Parameter fields as <V> vectors with no maximum. Chosen: same as protocol decision mimid-1wgh.5.34 — no invented per-field caps; RFC 9420 §2.1.2 2^30-1 limit (tls_codec mls feature, MAX_VECTOR_LENGTH) plus a named total body cap at the hub/server trust boundary.
